scenarios.name: Help / Usage
scenarios.output:
usage: ai-sentry [-h] [--version] <command> ...

AI-SENTRY — LLM Security Orchestration Platform
Run multi-engine adversarial scans on language models.

positional arguments:
  <command>    Available commands
    scan       Run a security scan against a target model.
    healthcheck
               Verify that all bundled engines and dependencies are
               functional.
    version    Print the AI-SENTRY version and exit.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --version    show program's version number and exit

scenarios.name: Scan Help
scenarios.output:
usage: ai-sentry scan [-h] --target <endpoint_or_path> [--api-key <key>]
                      [--depth <depth>] [--output <path>]

Perform adversarial security testing on an LLM endpoint or local model.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target <endpoint_or_path>
                        API endpoint URL (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1) or
                        path to a local GGUF model file.
  --api-key <key>       API key for the target endpoint. Can also be set via
                        the AI_SENTRY_API_KEY environment variable.
  --depth <depth>       Scan depth profile: quick | standard | deep (default:
                        standard)
  --output <path>       Directory to write scan reports into (default:
                        ./aisentry-report)
